text:
maya: Quick coord — planning a gradual exposure for structured-output (SO) + function-calling. Draft plan below, want sign-off on flag names, audiences, and guardrails. Will roll internal -> alpha -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated rollback on schema regressions.

maya: Proposed flags/config (please review):
```
# feature flags
so_expose=true
so_compat_mode=opt_in    # opt_in | strict | legacy_fallback
fncall_enabled=true
sdk_default_opt_in=false  # public SDKs default to false, dev builds true
canary_audiences=["internal","beta_customers","random:1%"]
validation_mode=schema_and_score  # reject | fallback | score_and_alert
```

maya: Guardrails I'm asking for:
- server-side schema validation with auto-fallback to legacy generate when validation fails
- telemetry tags: schema_failures, fallback_count, latency_p50/p95, token_cost
- rollout throttling if schema_failures > 0.5% for 15m
- QA smoke suite run on every canary increment

raj: Can we lock down exact flag names and defaults in one place (console + infra config)? Also how will the console UI show compat mode? I want a clear enum so we don't diverge.

cody: SDK note: opt-in=false by default is safer for public releases; some customers expect the old text-only path. Will update client SDK to expose an explicit `enableStructuredOutput` option and make the public NPM default false.

cody: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/456 (WIP) — adds header `X-Compat-Mode` and client opt-in flag. Ping me for review.

emma: On model fallback: ensure we have compatible model variants pinned (eg: gptx-so-v1, gptx-so-v1-quant). If a model variant can't produce valid schema, route to legacy_generate with a note. Also add token budget guard per request to avoid huge cost from malformed prompts.

sam: I'll create the rollout plan in the Console and wire the audiences. Proposed percent schedule: internal (1 day) -> alpha customers (48h) -> 1% (24h) -> 5% (24h) -> 20% (48h) -> 100%. We'll run daily evals on the sample prompt set and failgate on schema regression > 0.3% or fallback_count spike.

maya: Added a short checklist in the PR description for infra and QA. Also link to the smoke eval: https://internals.redwood/evals/so-smoke

maya: Two questions for eng-sre/infra: 1) do we need a separate rate limit bucket for SO responses? 2) want to add an emergency kill-switch that can disable `so_expose` globally without a deploy.

raj: Answering quick: 1) yes, let's create a per-route rate limit for `so` routes to protect cost SLOs. 2) emergency kill-switch — we have a lambda-backed toggle in infra already; I can add a route to the console and a runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle run: so_expose -> enable (dry-run) at 2025-11-12T15:00:00Z. Will run smoke tests post-toggle and post results to this thread.

raj: Small ask — can we add `X-Compat-Mode: so_v1` header on client requests so we can filter telemetry from older clients?

cody: yep, adding header and a small unit test. Will also ship a migration note in CHANGELOG.

emma: I'll add telemetry metrics to the model team board and a Grafana dashboard for schema_failures + fallback_count.

sam: QA will run the smoke set after each ramp and post a short pass/fail note here.

maya: Thanks all — if nobody objects I'll mark this ready to schedule and Sam/Kayla can start configuring audiences tomorrow. :thumbsup:

raj: LGTM.

cody: Working on the SDK PR, will ping when ready for QA. :rocket:
